anchors.label: ASSETTYPE
anchors.regex: (?:^|\|\s*)(?:Asset-Backed Securities|Common Stocks|LLC Interests|Preferred Stocks|Senior Secured Loans)(?:\s*\||$)

notes: Identifier strings use pipe-delimited asset type, industry, issuer/instrument/tranche, rate descriptor or reference-rate spread, stated percentage, and maturity date when present.
